content.text:
I took the second Seal-Stone from the drowned hall at Gemin, and the game is over. I only looked around and spoke to the Warden, who had nothing to say. I didn't fight, sneak past or turn any of the dead. The stone was there to take.

The tablet beside it says the Eye, lifted, parts every tree from every other. Used where it sits, it strengthens them.

I now hold two stones, from Blackrose and Gemin. The third is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, reached by boat near Noota Nara. All three go into the gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.

Still unanswered:
- Why the Unbound drain the trees they seal.
- What is in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and where its key is.
- How Nesh-Deeka knows so much about the Unbound.

The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is still hunting the same relics. I gave the game my final notes covering all of this.
